fields.label: Company
fields.description: The entity this equity movement belongs to.

fields.label: Fiscal Year
fields.description: Year the movement is recorded in (e.g. 2024).

fields.options:
FY
Q1
Q2
Q3
Q4
H1
H2
fields.label: Period
fields.description: FY for annual statements; Q1-Q4 for quarterly; H1/H2 for half-yearly. Pick the period you're reporting.

fields.label: Equity Component
fields.description: Which equity line this movement affects. The list is configurable — manage entries via Insight Equity Component.

fields.label: Movement Type
fields.description: What kind of movement this is. The list is configurable — manage entries via Insight Equity Movement Type. The system identifies the opening entry by the 'Is Opening Balance' flag on the type, not by its name.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Signed amount in the company's base currency. Positive = increases the component; negative = decreases. Beginning Balance is always positive.

fields.label: Narration
fields.description: Optional explanation — e.g. 'Transfer per board resolution dated 15-Mar-2024'.

fields.label: Report (optional)
fields.description: Optionally tie this movement to a specific Insight report definition. If left empty, all reports for the same company/year see it.
